title: Stochastic Mixed-Integer Optimization of Dynamic Electricity Tariffs with Consumer Protection
summary: Day-ahead residential tariffs must be posted before demand is observed. Aggressive high prices can cut peaks in simulation, but they can also raise customer bills. This paper measures how much peak reduction is lost when a tariff design problem is required to keep revenue near a flat-tariff baseline and to limit bill increases.
